actions.objective: Run Windows 3.11 for Workgroups in QEMU from /app/isos/win311.img in snapshot mode, expose VNC on :1 (port 5901), provide nginx web access on port 80, and leave the VM running in the background at the Windows 3.11 desktop with programmatic keyboard input enabled.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process using /app/isos/win311.img in snapshot mode
Evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop
Evidence that QEMU accepts programmatic keyboard input beyond VNC-only interaction
required_behaviors: Start QEMU in the background and keep it running
Configure snapshot mode so the base image remains immutable
Expose a mechanism for external/programmatic keyboard control
Provide nginx web interface on port 80 for remote access
known_invalid_patterns: Compile/smoke checks that do not demonstrate the VM is running and reachable
Prompt echo or configuration text without runtime verification
VNC-only interaction without evidence of programmatic keyboard control
verification_plan: Launch QEMU with the required flags and background it
Verify listening sockets for VNC and nginx
Connect to VNC or otherwise verify the Windows 3.11 desktop is displayed
Verify a programmatic keyboard path works against the running VM
Collect receipts for each verification step
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt showing QEMU launched with snapshot mode and VNC :1
Receipt showing nginx is listening on port 80
Receipt-backed evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop
Receipt-backed evidence that programmatic keyboard input is configured and usable
